s: Dinim hashshayyakim leereb shabbat ubo y"g seipim: asur leadam sheyyehallek beereb shabbat yoter mig' parsaot mittechillat hayyom, kede sheyyaggia limqom shebitato beod hayyom gadol, veyukal lehakin sham tzorke shabbat. Vaapillu im hu beinyan sheim yelek yoter yaggia lebeto, ubene beto epshar shessamu el libbam shemma yabo hayyom vehekinu gam bishbilo — ap al pi ken asur, shemma lo samu el libbam kelal mibbiato velo hekinu lo kelum. Abal im yadua lahem bevadday sheyyabo hayyom, kegon sheshshalach lahem shaliach lehodiam, o shehodiam qodem nesiato mibbeto — muttar lo lelek kol hayyom:

Vekol zeh keshehu bemaqom sheyyukal lehakin sham tzorke shabbat o sheacherim yakinu lo, abal im hu bemaqom shei epshar lehakin tzorke shabbat vegam acherim lo yakinu lo — mutab sheyyelek apillu kamma parsaot, ulay yaggia lemaqom sheyyukal lehakin sham tzorke shabbat o sheacherim yakinu lo, mishsheyyishshaer sham, shebbevadday lo yukal lehakin. Vaapillu im yesh immo tzeda kede tzorke shabbat, mikkol maqom im hu bemaqom sheeno yishshub batuach — muttar lo lelek mishsham apillu kamma parsaot ad sheyyaggia limqom yishshub batuach, shekkesheeno bimqom yishshub batuach — en lo oneg shabbat kelal.

Vekol zeh kesheholek beraglayv, abal im rokeb al sus o holek beqaron — yakol lelek kamma parsaot, veap al pi ken yukal lehaggia limqom shebitato beod hayyom gadol. (Umikkol maqom, lo yehallek yoter mikkede shiur shehu mahalak g' parsaot shel adam benoni hamhallek beraglayv, dehaynu d' shaot ved' chomashim mishshaot benonit shehen k"d lemeet leet, ayyen simman tn"t):
Ubimdinot ellu rob bene adam mekinim tzorke shabbat berevach, laken en nizharim kelal millelek yoter mig' parsaot bekol inyan kesheholek lebeto o lehitareach bebet acherim:

Asur liqboa beereb shabbat seudda gedola shel mishteh sheeno ragil bah bime hachol, mippene kebod hashshabbat, sheal yede shemmarbeh baakila ushetiyya beereb shabbat apillu babboqer yoter middarko bishar yemot hachol — lo yukal leqayyem seuddat shabbat shebballayla karauy:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bisuddat hareshut, o apillu seuddat mitzva ella sheen zemannah beereb shabbat, sheyyakol lidchotah leyom acher velaasot hasseudda beoto yom. Abal im zemannah hayyom, kegon seuddat mila useuddat erusin venissuin, sheen lo lidchot haerusin shemma yeqaddemennu acher leorsah, veken hannissuin en lo lidchot shello lehibbatel mipperiyya urebiyya, veken hammila ap im enah bashshemini leledato i epshar lidchotah leyom acher, sheasur lehannicho arel apillu yom echad, lepikak muttar laasot hasseudda gam ken bo bayyom, veim achar kak lo yukal leqayyem seuddat shabbat shebballayla — en bekak kelum, kevan shezzohi gam ken seuddat mitzva, veyokal lemachar bayyom shalosh seuddot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"d:

Umikkol maqom, mitzva lehatchil hasseudda lekattechilla qodem shaa asirit, shehare mishshaa asirit veelak mitzva lehimmana milliqboa apillu seudda qetanna sheragil bah bechol im hi seuddat hareshut, kemo sheyyitbaer, im ken gam bisuddat mitzva, kevan sheepshar lehaqdimah qodem shaa asirit — yesh lo lehaqdimah lekattechilla. Vetob shello leekol bisudda zo ella minyan metzumtzam, lebad min hashshayyakim lasseudda, kegon haqqerobim vehashshoshebinim bisuddat nissuin, vehaqqerobim ubaale habberit, dehaynu hammohel vehassandaq bisuddat mila:

Seuddat pidyon habben bizmanno, dehaynu beyom l"a leledato — dinah kisuddat mila. Abal im era ezeh ones shello pedao beyom l"a — en lipdoto beereb shabbat velaasot az seudda shel mishteh, dekevan shekkebar nidchet hammitzva mizzemanna — yidchenna gam ken meereb shabbat, mippene kebod hashshabbat (ella yipdennu belo seudda shel mishteh). Veken mi sheeras qodem ereb shabbat veereo ones shello haya yakol laasot hasseudda beyom haerusin — lo yaasenna beereb shabbat, dekevan shekkebar nidchet mizzemannah, dehaynu yom haerusin — yidchenna gam ken mippene kebod hashshabbat. (Abal benissuin nimsheket mitzvat hasseudda [z'] yamim achar hachuppa, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tr"m):

Seudda sheragil bah bimot hachol, dehaynu seudda qetanna sheenah shel mishteh — min haddin muttar leoklah bekol hayyom apillu samuk lachasheka. Abal mitzva lehimmana milleqobah mittechillat shaa asirit veelak, kede sheyyikkanes leshabbat keshehu taeb leekol veyokal seuddat shabbat leteabon. Abal leekol velishtot beli qebiut seudda — eno nimna beereb shabbat ubeereb yom tob ad shechasheka, dehaynu ad ben hashshemashot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"[a], chutz meereb pesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ta"a:

Abal leachar shechasheka, o leachar sheqqibbel alayv shabbat apillu mibbeod yom (im dato lehatchil seuddat shabbat qodem shechasheka[)] — mitzva lehimmana milleekol shum dabar apillu belo qebiut seudda apillu leachar sheqqiddesh al hakkos qodem akilat iqqar seuddat shabbat, dehaynu millechem shemmebarekim alayv "hammotzi", shehu iqqar seuddat shabbat, shemmibbilado eno yotze yede chobat g' seuddot, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"d, lepi sheim yokal mimmaakal acher qodem akilat hallechem — lo yokal hallechem leteabon. (Umikkol maqom, en limchot beyad hammeqillin, kevan shemmin haddin en chiyyub gamur leekol seuddat shabbat leteabon, kemo shennitbaer):

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheokel oto maakal qodem hasseudda mechamat shechapetz umitavveh leoklo qodem hasseudda velo betok hasseudda, abal im mah sheokelo qodem hasseudda hu mechamat sherotzeh lehashlim mea berakot al yede shemmebarek alayv gam beraka acharona kesheokelo qodem hasseudda, sheeno niptar bebirkat hammazon shelleachar hasseudda — yesh bezeh (issur gamur min haddin, sheasur ligrom chiyyub beraka kesheepshar lepotrah bibraka acheret, kemo shennitbaer besimman [r]t"v. Veod yesh) issur bemah shemmaqdim birkat oto maakal lebirkat hallechem, shebbirkat hallechem qodemet lekol habberakot, kemo shennitbaer besimman ry"a, mah sheen ken kesheokelo qodem hasseudda mechamat sheeno chapetz umitavveh leoklo kelal betok hasseudda ella qodem hasseudda — azay eno tzarik kelal lehaqdim lepanayv birkat hallechem, ayyen simman ry"a:

En qobeim taanit lekattechilla beereb shabbat, ella im ken sheyyitom meat qodem qabbalat shabbat, kede shello yikkanes leshabbat keshehu meunneh. Ella im ken hu isetnis, shekkesheokel bayyom apillu meat — lo yokal ballayla leteabon. Bammeh debarim amurim? Betaanit yachid sheen qabua lo zeman, sheepshar lo lehitannot oto taanit beyom acher. Abal im zemanno hu beereb shabbat, kegon hammitanneh taaniyyot shel yeme mitat hatztzaddiqim sheyyitbaer besimman tq"p, veken hammitanneh beereb rosh chodesh — eno tzarik lidchot hattaanit leyom acher im era beereb shabbat (veken hammitanneh bekol yemot hashshabua, shebbeoto yom mitanneh hu gam ken ). Veap al pi shekkol hattaaniyyot ellu shebbeereb shabbat enam choba kelal — en tzarik lidchoto mippene kebod hashshabbat, lepi sheissur zeh shello yikkanes leshabbat keshehu meunneh issur qal hu, velo chasheshu lo ella shello liqboa bo hattaanit lekattechilla kesheepshar leqobo beyom acher, abal mi shei epshar lo leqobo beyom acher — en lo lidchot hattaanit legamre bishbil kak. Verashshay lehashlim hattaanit beereb shabbat ad tzet hakkokabim. Veim qibbel alayv hattaanit bemincha — chayyab hu lehashlimo, kemo hamqabbel alayv taanit bishar yemot hashshabua shechayyab hu lehashlimo ad tzet hakkokabim. Veyesh omerim sheim hishlim tepillat arbit shel shabbat mibbeod yom — tzarik leekol miyyad, veeno rashshay lehitannot ad tzet hakkokabim, dekevan sheqqibbel alayv shabbat bitpilla asur lo lehitannot od, sheen mitannin beshabbat apillu shaa achat keshemmitkavven leshem taanit, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rp"ch. Veap im qibbel hattaanit bemincha shechayyab hu lehashlimo — ap al pi ken yokal miyyad leachar hashlamat (hatztzibbur et) hattepilla, lepi shehu mitanneh ad achar qabbalat shabbat — zehu gam ken hashlama, shekkebar nishlam yom hachol vechal alayv hashshabbat. Uleinyan halaka, yesh linhog kisbara haacharona betaanit yachid, sheen chiyyub hahashlama bo ella mechamat qabbalato oto, vekevan shemmitanneh ad achar qabbalat shabbat yotze yede chobato. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla yeparesh bishat qabbalat hattaanit sheeno meqabbelo ella ad leachar yetzia mibbet hakkeneset. Abal betaanit tzibbur shehahashlama bo hu choba — tzarik lehashlim gam beereb shabbat kisbara harishona. Vaapillu im hitna meetmol shello yitanneh ella ad leachar yetzia mibbet hakkeneset — en tenao moil kelum, sheen hattaanit taluy kelal bitnao, shehare hu taanit tzibbur. Veim hu taanit chalom — ledibre hakkol yashlim ad tzet hakkokabim, shehare ap beshabbat atzmah mitannin taanit chalom:

Hammitanneh bekol ereb chodesh, o bekol aseret yeme teshuba, o bek' sivan, o bemitat hatztzaddiqim, o beyom shemmet bo abiv veimmo, im bappaam harishon sheera hattaanit beereb shabbat hishlimo ad tzet hakkokabim — tzarik linhog ken leolam bekol paam sheyyeera beereb shabbat, mishshum shehu kemo neder, vetzarik sheyyattiru lo shelosha. Vehu shebbeshaa shehishlim bappaam harishon haya bedato linhog ken leolam, o shehishlim g' peamim beereb shabbat velo hitna sheyyehe beli neder, abal mechamat shehishlim kamma peamim kesheera bechol — eno chashub keneder, leinyan sheyyitztarek lehashlim kesheera beereb shabbat. Veyesh choleqin bezeh veomerim shebbetaanit yom shemmet bo abiv veimmo keshechal bechol beshana harishona vehishlim az hattaanit bevadday haya bedato linhog ken leolam, lepi shello ala al dato lachshob heak yitnaheg lehabba kesheyyeera beereb shabbat, lepikak hare zeh keneder vetzarik lehashlim leolam, ap kesheyyeera beereb shabbat. Veken betaanit yeme mitat hatztzaddiqim veereb rosh chodesh, im keshehitanna paam harishon bechol vehishlimo haya bedato linhog ken leolam, o shehitanna vehishlim g' peamim bechol velo hitna sheyyehe beli neder — hare zeh keneder, vetzarik lehashlim ap kesheyyeera beereb shabbat. Veken nahagu haolam (veap al pi ken hammeqel leet hatztzorek kisbara harishona — lo hipsid):
